audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing is fine (FAVOURED 4/10) but the level chart calls every stage 8/10 Akshan against a 49.83% win rate over 2950 games, including 2+ items where a fully augmented Viktor out-damages Akshan in a set fight.
audit.why: Akshan's edge is the level 1-6 three-hit string against an immobile mage; it does not persist once Viktor has Hex Fragment augments and fights start on his terms.
audit.corrected: Akshan owns levels 1 through first item; the last row flips to Viktor, who wins any fight that begins before Akshan's flank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes referenced 'Hex Core upgrades' and 'Power Transfer' — neither exists in Riot's current Viktor kit — and claimed Akshan 'stun-combos', which he has no stun for.
audit.why: Viktor's passive is Glorious Evolution: he gains Hex Fragments on kills and augments an ability per 100. His Q is Siphon Power, E is Hextech Ray, R is Arcane Storm.
audit.corrected: Spike text now keyed to Heroic Swing coming online (18s at rank 1), level 6 Comeuppance vs Arcane Storm, first lethality item vs his augments, and the late duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive ultimate interaction was never stated: Arcane Storm interrupts enemy channels, and Comeuppance is a channel. The Siphon Power auto-reset wind-up tell was also absent.
audit.why: Riot's Arcane Storm text explicitly says it interrupts enemy channels; Akshan's R stores bullets while locked on, so a storm on top of him cancels a 100-second ultimate. Viktor's Q empowers his next basic attack (autoReset flag plus Riot text), so the attack wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Never start Comeuppance inside Arcane Storm; read the empowered-auto wind-up rather than the Q cast.
sources: champ-data/_kits/viktor.json (R text: 'interrupting enemy channels'; Q text: 'empowers his next basic attack')

audit.whatIsWrong: 'fifteen-second invitation' for a missed Gravity Field.
audit.why: Gravity Field is 17/16/15/14/13 — fifteen seconds is rank 3, not the lane-phase number.
Hextech Ray is 525 range and must be aimed through the target line; Akshan's Avengerang is 850 and double-passes. Range asymmetry now stated in the late text.

edits.before: Viktor is immobile before he hits his power spikes, so once E is online you can swing in and punish any Siphon Power stack attempt or missed Gravity Field zone before he can safely disengage.
edits.after: Viktor is immobile, so once Heroic Swing is online at 18s you can punish a whiffed Gravity Field — 17 seconds with no lockdown, and Siphon Power alone cannot stop your three-hit string.

edits.before: Comeuppance is a strong answer to Chaos Storm — if he ults to zone a teamfight or push a wave, you can R in and either kill him before the storm ramps up or force him to waste it early.
edits.after: Arcane Storm interrupts channels, so it cancels Comeuppance mid-store — hold your ult until his storm is spent or you stand outside it, then chip him and execute from range.

edits.before: Once you have your first lethality item, you can punish his Hex Core upgrades before they matter — dash in during his Power Transfer cast animation and stun-combo him down before Gravity Field traps you.
edits.after: Once you have your first lethality item, punish his Hex Fragment augments before they matter — Siphon Power's auto reset is the wind-up tell, so swing in on that cast and burst him outside Gravity Field.

edits.before: Viktor's Chaos Storm zoning is scary in teamfights, but in a direct duel you close distance with camouflage and E mobility faster than he can kite, letting your burst outpace his DPS.
edits.after: Viktor's Arcane Storm zoning is scary in teamfights, but in a duel Going Rogue camouflage and the swing close the 700-range gap faster than he can kite, letting your burst outpace his DPS.

edits.before: Viktor has almost no mobility or escape before level 6, so once your kit is fully online at level 3 you can consistently punish his Power Transfer stacking attempts with dash-ins and stuns. He'll try to zone you with Gravity Field, but the field has a long cooldown and telegraphed cast, so baiting it out before all-in nets you a clean kill window most games.
edits.after: Viktor has no mobility or escape, so once your kit is online at level 3 you can punish his Siphon Power step-ups — the auto reset wind-up is the tell, not the cast. He zones with Gravity Field, but it is a 17-second cooldown at rank 1 and the field is visible before it stuns, so walk out of the ring and commit the moment it drops.

edits.before: Chaos Storm gives him some teamfight and wave-clear presence at 6, but Comeuppance is a hard counter if he tries to use it aggressively — you can dive in and either kill him or force the ult to whiff. Continue pressuring his lack of escape and punishing any overextension for stacks.
edits.after: Arcane Storm gives him teamfight and wave-clear presence at 6, and it interrupts channels — never start Comeuppance inside the storm or it is cancelled and the 100-second cooldown is gone. Punish his lack of escape between casts; his augments come from kills, so deny them.

edits.before: Viktor's damage output scales hard with Hex Core, but he remains immobile outside of Gravity Field, so your camouflage flanks and E swing-ins consistently close the gap before his laser can free-cast. Focus him down fast in skirmishes rather than letting him set up from range.
edits.after: Viktor's damage scales hard with his Hex Fragment augments, but he stays immobile, and Hextech Ray is a 525-range line he must aim through you. Camouflage flanks and swing-ins close that gap before he can free-cast — focus him first in skirmishes instead of letting him set up from range.

edits.before: Kit completion at level 3 lets you consistently dive and punish his stacking pattern.
edits.after: Kit complete at level 3: your swing-ins punish every Siphon Power step-up he takes.

edits.before: Continued dash pressure keeps him on the back foot as he tries to scale.
edits.after: Swing pressure keeps him on the back foot while he tries to scale safely.

edits.before: Comeuppance directly counters his global zoning ultimate, keeping level 6 in your favor.
edits.after: Arcane Storm interrupts channels, so time Comeuppance for when his storm is down.

edits.before: Mobility and camouflage let you close distance faster than his kit can kite, winning duels late.
edits.after: Fully augmented, his teamfight damage beats yours if the fight starts before your flank.
